resources.string: Mirror your tablet screen to the classroom whiteboard, wirelessly.
You can stop from the notification or this screen.
The tablet and the board must be on the same Wi-Fi network. The school network may block devices from seeing each other: try turning on the tablet\'s hotspot and connecting the board to it.
CastHop is not running on the board
Open the CastHop app on the board and scan the new QR code.
This QR code belongs to another board or a device on the network is intercepting the connection. Scan the current QR code on the board.
The QR code is no longer valid
Each QR code works only once. Scan the new QR code on the board.
Another tablet is mirroring and the switch was not allowed.
The approval prompt on the board was not answered in time. Try again.
Wait a few seconds and try again.
Too many wrong codes. Wait 30 seconds and use the new code on the board.
Update the tablet app and CastHop on the board.
No suitable video encoder was found on this tablet.
To mirror, tap \"Start\" in the system dialog.
Check the Wi-Fi connection and connect again.
Choose \"Balanced\" or \"Weak network\" in Settings and try again.
Mirroring was stopped on the board.
CastHop was closed on the board.
The board allowed another tablet to mirror.
Mirroring ends when the screen locks or it is stopped by the system. You can connect again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Point the camera at the QR code on the board
This is not a CastHop code. Scan the QR code on the board.
The camera could not be opened.
A few permissions are needed first
To read the QR code on the board. Nothing is recorded.
To connect to the board on the same network.
To show a stop button in the notification while mirroring.
Some permissions were not granted. You can enable them in Settings.
720p, 30 fps for crowded or 2.4 GHz networks.
Only values supported by this tablet are shown. The board and network may still lower them.
Tap to open or press Stop.
The tablet and the board are on different networks
The tablet does not seem to be on the board\'s network. Connect the tablet to the same Wi-Fi as the board, or try the hotspot option below.
The board no longer knows this tablet
The pairing may have been removed on the board. Scan the QR code on the board again.
If the school network blocks it: use the tablet\'s hotspot
Paused. The board keeps the last picture; your screen is not shared until you resume.
Connect with one tap to boards you have scanned once.
To play the tablet\'s sound (videos, app sounds) on the board. Android requires this permission, but the microphone is not recorded.
Sound is playing on the board.
Sound is off on the board; it plays on the tablet.
Sound is not shared: permission not granted.
Sound cannot be shared between this tablet and board.
Sound could not be shared; video continues.
Video and app sounds play from the board\'s speakers. Some apps (e.g. calls, some video apps) do not allow their sound to be shared.
Searching for boards on the same network…
Board not listed? Is CastHop open on the board and the tablet on the same network? School networks may block discovery; the QR code always works.
Enter the 6-digit code shown on the board.
Enter the current 6-digit code shown on the board. After 5 wrong attempts the code changes and you must wait 30 seconds.
If the board can decode it in hardware, the same quality needs less data. Otherwise H.264 is used.
Open this screen while mirroring: the board shows the time between the tablet drawing a frame and the board displaying it.
The board shows \"end-to-end … ms\" in its info bar. Manual method: photograph the tablet and the board together; the difference between the two clocks is the latency.
Open CastHop on the board. A QR code and a 6-digit code appear.
Keep the tablet and the board on the same Wi-Fi network.
On the first connection the app shows which permissions it needs and why.
On the tablet, tap \"Connect to board\" (\"New board with QR\" if you already have remembered boards).
Point the camera at the QR code on the board.
Answer \"Start\" to Android\'s screen sharing prompt.
Pick your board from the boards on the same network.
Enter the 6-digit code shown on the board.
Answer \"Start\" to Android\'s screen sharing prompt.
A board you have connected to appears under \"Remembered boards\" on the home screen.
Tap its name and answer \"Start\". CastHop must be open on the board.
\"Pause\" keeps the last picture on the board while you do something else on the tablet.
To stop, tap \"Stop mirroring\" or \"Stop\" in the notification.
If Wi-Fi drops briefly, mirroring recovers by itself.
The picture stutters or looks blurry
In Settings, set picture quality to \"Balanced\" or \"Weak network\". Prefer 5 GHz Wi-Fi.
Check that the sound permission was granted and that \"Play sound on the board\" is on in Settings. Some apps do not allow their audio to be shared.
Mirroring stops when the screen locks
This is a security rule on Android 15 and later. Increase the tablet\'s screen timeout.
On the tablet, open Settings → Connections → Mobile hotspot.
On the board, join the tablet\'s network from the network icon.
Scan the new QR code that appears on the board.
